description: ECS v2 — 11-field contract enforcement + 4 new field processors

script.description: PROCESSOR 1: ECS Guardian — Reject non-compliant documents
script.source: def required = ['@timestamp', 'source.ip', 'event.category', 'ecs.version']; for (def field : required) { if (!ctx.containsKey(field) || ctx[field] == null) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('ECS_VIOLATION: Missing required field: ' + field); } } if (!ctx['ecs']['version'].equals('8.11.0')) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('ECS_VIOLATION: ecs.version must be 8.11.0, got: ' + ctx['ecs']['version']); }

if (ctx?.aws?.cloudtrail?.user_identity?.access_key_id != null) { ctx['iam_access_key_id'] = ctx.aws.cloudtrail.user_identity.access_key_id; } else if (ctx?.aws?.cloudtrail?.response_elements?.accessKey?.accessKeyId != null) { ctx['iam_access_key_id'] = ctx.aws.cloudtrail.response_elements.accessKey.accessKeyId; } else if (ctx?.event?.dataset == 'aws.cloudtrail' && ctx?.event?.action == 'ConsoleLogin') { ctx['iam_access_key_id'] = 'CONSOLE_SESSION'; } else { ctx['iam_access_key_id'] = 'UNKNOWN'; }

if (ctx?.cloud?.region != null) { ctx['aws_region'] = ctx.cloud.region; } else if (ctx?.aws?.cloudtrail?.aws_region != null) { ctx['aws_region'] = ctx.aws.cloudtrail.aws_region; } else { ctx['aws_region'] = 'UNKNOWN'; }

boolean isAdmin = false; String signal = 'NONE'; if (ctx?.labels?.policy_arn != null) { def adminPolicies = ['AdministratorAccess', 'PowerUserAccess']; for (def p : adminPolicies) { if (ctx.labels.policy_arn.contains(p)) { isAdmin = true; signal = 'POLICY_ATTACH'; break; } } } if (!isAdmin && ctx?.event?.action == 'AssumeRole') { def roleArn = ctx?.aws?.cloudtrail?.request_parameters?.roleArn ?: ''; if (roleArn.toLowerCase().contains('admin')) { isAdmin = true; signal = 'ASSUME_ROLE'; } } ctx['admin_session_active'] = isAdmin; if (ctx['labels'] == null) { ctx['labels'] = [:]; } ctx['labels']['admin_detection_signal'] = signal;
